items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Once or twice I heard her with Punch.

ctx.x: Well, Billy Pierce, of course, there's always been a lot of women here to play the dance. Who's with Tom Shorten? There's Mercedees, I forget, what is her name, Gorman, Mercedees Gorman, does you know her? Is she still around? I've never met her. Not sure.
I think she rhymed with Selty. I don't know, I don't remember, for quite a while she played at a gig. Yeah, I think she played with Punch. Oh, with Punch? Once or twice I heard her with Punch.
Yeah, but I don't know her.
